run_scheduled_events: run a simulation environment that schedules email events to occur at specific times after start
create_conditional_events: create conditional events that trigger when a custom condition on the environment event log is met
schedule_event_from_function: schedule an event using Event.from_function with a delayed or absolute time syntax
capture_agent_events: capture agent events using EventRegisterer capture mode to record App API calls as events
start_and_pause_environment: start the simulation environment, interact with registered apps, then pause and inspect the event log
